_about: Editable rules that map the free-text 'Individuals Involved' roles in a ProbeMatrix findings export to the Learnings Coach organisational taxonomy. F = functional entity (who owns the learning), T = organisational tier (which level learns), R = relation of the role to the factor. Regexes are case-insensitive. A role may belong to several F entities (all matching rules apply, minus 'exclude'). Each entity carries 'tags' (operations, engineering, supply, contractor, emergency, assurance, people, leadership, corporate, external); the audience skills select by tag, so a custom taxonomy keeps working when it gives its entities the same tags. T takes the first tier whose 'match' hits; only when none does, the first whose 'weak' hits. R takes the first match. Site- or country-specific role words belong in an overlay (references/overlays/, classify --overlay NAME), not here. Roles that match nothing are listed for an LLM resolution pass (see skills/learning-clusters).
